explanation: A loose net of nerves runs through its body instead of a brain, and oxygen soaks straight through its thin tissues, so it needs no heart or blood.

claims.text: Jellyfish have no brain, no heart and no blood.
Octopuses, seahorses and sharks all have a brain, a heart and blood.
Jellyfish have a nerve net instead of a centralized brain.
Oxygen diffuses directly through a jellyfish's thin body layers.
